title: The Curse of Black Sigatoka: A Backward Bifurcation Perspective
summary: Black Sigatoka disease (BSD), also known as black leaf streak disease, is an airborne fungal infection caused by \textit{Pseudocercospora fijiensis} that severely impacts global banana and plantain production. Its persistence and resistance to eradication make it one of the most challenging plant diseases to manage. In this paper, we propose a deterministic pathogen-host model to describe BSD dynamics.
